title: A protocol for metabolic characterization of human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes (iPS-CM)
author: House, Fatica, et al.

steps.title: Harvest iPS‑CM and quench metabolism
steps.instruction: Aspirate culture media, wash cells twice with 1 mL cold PBS then once with water (do not let water remain >30 s), add 1 mL cold acetonitrile, incubate at –20 °C for 20 min (protein precipitate forms), add 0.75 mL cold water, scrape cells with a plastic scraper, transfer lysate to a 10 mL centrifuge tube; repeat the acetonitrile‑water‑scrape‑collect sequence once more to ensure complete recovery.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate media from the well.
Wash cells twice with 1 mL cold PBS.
Wash cells once with water, keeping water on cells ≤30 s.
Add 1 mL cold acetonitrile, incubate –20 °C 20 min.
Add 0.75 mL cold water, scrape cells, collect lysate.
Repeat the acetonitrile‑water‑scrape step once more.

steps.title: Add internal standards to lysate
steps.instruction: Prepare internal‑standard working solutions and add them to the combined lysate: NSK‑A stock is made by reconstituting the vial in 2 mL water:methanol (1:1 v/v) giving the following concentrations – Alanine‑d4 250 nmol/mL, L‑Phenylalanine‑13C6 250 nmol/mL, L‑Leucine‑d3 250 nmol/mL, L‑Valine‑d8 250 nmol/mL, L‑Arginine‑HCl‑13C/‑d4 250 nmol/L, L‑Citrulline‑d2 250 nmol/mL, L‑Tyrosine‑13C6 250 nmol/mL, L‑Ornithine‑HCl‑d2 250 nmol/mL, L‑Methionine‑d3 250 nmol/mL, DL‑Glutamic Acid‑d3 250 nmol/mL, L‑Aspartic Acid‑d3 250 nmol/mL, Glycine‑13C/15N 500 nmol/mL. Dilute this stock 1:10 in methanol to obtain the working solution and add 50 µL to the lysate. NSK‑B stock is made by reconstituting its vial in 2 mL methanol giving – Free Carnitine 76 nmol/mL, Acetyl‑carnitine‑d3 19 nmol/mL, Propionyl‑carnitine‑d3 3.8 nmol/mL, Butyryl‑carnitine‑d3 3.8 nmol/mL, Isovaleryl‑carnitine‑d9 3.8 nmol/mL, Octanoyl‑carnitine‑d3 3.8 nmol/mL, Myristoyl‑carnitine‑d9 3.8 nmol/mL, Palmitoyl‑carnitine‑d3 7.6 nmol/mL. Dilute this stock 1:10⁶ in methanol to obtain the working solution and add 100 µL to the lysate. Finally, add 25 µL of 1 mM tricarballylic acid for the GC‑MS metabolic profile.

substeps.instruction: Prepare NSK‑A stock (2 mL H₂O:MeOH 1:1) with listed labeled amino acids.
Dilute NSK‑A 1:10 in methanol; add 50 µL to lysate.
Prepare NSK‑B stock (2 mL MeOH) with listed labeled acylcarnitines.
Dilute NSK‑B 1:10⁶ in methanol; add 100 µL to lysate.
Add 25 µL of 1 mM tricarballylic acid.

steps.title: Phase separation with chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL cold chloroform to the lysate, vortex, centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 15 min (4 °C). After centrifugation, collect 250 µL of the upper polar phase for amino‑acid/acylcarnitine analysis (label “amino acids and acylcarnitines”), and combine the remaining upper polar phase with the lower non‑polar phase in a clean tube (label “small cellular metabolites by GC/MS”).

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL cold chloroform, vortex.
Centrifuge 5000 rpm 15 min.
Transfer 250 µL upper polar phase to a clean tube (label).
Combine remaining upper polar phase with lower non‑polar phase; label.

steps.title: Process protein pellet
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL cold methanol to the protein/DNA inter‑phase pellet, evaporate the solvent under a nitrogen stream at room temperature, then re‑suspend the protein in an appropriate buffer for quantification by Bradford or bicinchoninic acid (BCA) assay.

steps.title: Derivatize amino acids & acylcarnitines
steps.instruction: Dry the 250 µL polar aliquot (step 3) together with the added internal standards, add 60 µL HCl‑n‑butanol, cap and incubate at 65 °C for 30 min; cool to room temperature, dry the sample again, re‑suspend in 100 µL mobile phase A and transfer to vials for LC‑MS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Dry the polar aliquot.
Add 60 µL HCl‑n‑butanol; incubate 65 °C 30 min.
Cool, dry again.
Re‑suspend in 100 µL mobile phase A; transfer to vials.

steps.title: Derivatize small metabolites (GC‑MS)
steps.instruction: Dry the combined polar and non‑polar phases (step 3), add 40 µL methoxyamine hydrochloride in pyridine (20 mg/mL), vortex and incubate at 80 °C for 1 h; cool, add 60 µL N,O‑Bis(trimethylsilyl)trifluoroacetamide (BSTFA), vortex and incubate at 70 °C for 30 min; cool and transfer the derivatized sample to GC‑MS vials.

substeps.instruction: Dry combined phases.
Add 40 µL methoxyamine·HCl in pyridine (20 mg/mL); incubate 80 °C 1 h.
Cool, add 60 µL BSTFA; incubate 70 °C 30 min.
Cool; transfer to GC‑MS vials.

steps.title: Set up 13C‑glucose uptake assay
steps.instruction: Grow iPS‑CM under standard conditions, aspirate media, wash twice with 1× D‑PBS, then add 2 mL RPMI‑1640 without glucose supplemented with 5–25 mM uniformly 13C₆‑glucose. During the experiment withdraw 75 µL media aliquots at 0, 30, 60, 120 and 240 min (use additional media if the experiment exceeds 6 h).

substeps.instruction: Grow cells and aspirate media.
Wash twice with 1× D‑PBS.
Add 2 mL RPMI‑1640 (no glucose) + 5–25 mM 13C₆‑glucose.
Collect 75 µL media at 0, 30, 60, 120, 240 min.

steps.title: Derivatize glucose‑uptake samples
steps.instruction: For each 75 µL media aliquot add 25 µL 1 mM galactose (internal standard), 400 µL methanol and 400 µL chloroform; vortex, centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 8 min, transfer the upper polar phase and dry under nitrogen at room temperature. Add 100 µL 0.2 M hydroxylamine hydrochloride in pyridine, cap and incubate at 90 °C for 40 min; cool, add 100 µL acetic anhydride and incubate at 90 °C for 60 min. Dry the derivatized sample under nitrogen and re‑suspend in 100 µL ethyl acetate before GC‑MS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 µL 1 mM galactose, 400 µL methanol, 400 µL chloroform; vortex.
Centrifuge 5000 rpm 8 min; transfer upper polar phase.
Dry under nitrogen at RT.
Add 100 µL 0.2 M hydroxylamine·HCl in pyridine; incubate 90 °C 40 min.
Cool, add 100 µL acetic anhydride; incubate 90 °C 60 min.
Dry under nitrogen; re‑suspend in 100 µL ethyl acetate.

steps.title: Derivatize lactate & pyruvate samples
steps.instruction: To each 75 µL media aliquot add 25 µL 1 mM tricarballylic acid and dry; then add 40 µL methoxyamine hydrochloride in pyridine (20 mg/mL), vortex and incubate at 80 °C for 1 h. Cool, add 60 µL MTBSTFA, vortex and heat at 70 °C for 30 min; finally cool and transfer the derivatized sample to GC‑MS vials.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 µL 1 mM tricarballylic acid; dry.
Add 40 µL methoxyamine·HCl in pyridine (20 mg/mL); incubate 80 °C 1 h.
Cool, add 60 µL MTBSTFA; incubate 70 °C 30 min.
Cool; transfer to GC‑MS vials.
